author: Donald Schön
title: The Reflective Practitioner
relevance: Design as reflective action in which moves are made, read and reframed rather than executed from a fixed answer.

author: Klaus Krippendorff
title: The Semantic Turn
relevance: Design meaning is produced through interpretation and use, not embedded in objects as a single stable property.

author: Kees Dorst
title: The Core of ‘Design Thinking’ and its Application
relevance: Frames design through abductive reasoning: exploring possible working principles and value configurations.

author: Lev Vygotsky
title: Thought and Language
relevance: Supports the role of language as a cognitive medium rather than a neutral wrapper around already-formed thought.

author: Alexander van Lamsweerde
title: Goal-Oriented Requirements Engineering
relevance: Shows how requirements, goals, alternatives and conflicts can be made explicit and traceable.

author: Christopher Alexander
title: Notes on the Synthesis of Form
relevance: Provides an early account of structuring design problems through relations, requirements and fit.

author: Bavelas & Chovil
title: Visible Acts of Meaning
relevance: Supports meaning as something actively produced and negotiated in communication.

author: Lakoff & Johnson
title: Metaphors We Live By
relevance: Demonstrates how conceptual framing influences what can be understood, inferred and acted upon.
